description: The flashpoint answer. A real checkpoint stands on one of the block's streets while it runs, so the prose and the mechanism are the same event seen from two distances.
name: The street is closed

stage.text: A loudhailer says something about compliance, twice, from further up.

lines: The street is full of uniforms. Anyone with somewhere else to be has gone there.
There's tape across the road and a person standing at each end of it.
A marshal is telling a queue of people that this won't take long.

stage.text: They have shut {place} off at both ends. Whatever that's about, it isn't a search for a bicycle.
A temporary closure is in effect in {place} — the operation is proceeding as planned and will conclude shortly.

stage.warn: Vehicles stop at the top of the street, and people start getting out of them.
